title: MIRTO: a registration-gated, multiverse-tested evaluation protocol for unsupervised anomaly segmentation in brain MRI
abstract: arXiv:2610.02136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection (UAD) methods for brain MRI are ranked by a single score, yet that score rests on choices that are rarely reported: how each anomaly map is aligned with the reference, how and on which data the threshold is set, and which false-positive budget, metric, aggregation and lesion definition are used. We present MIRTO, an evaluation protocol that makes these choices explicit and measures their effect. It gates the geometry of every comparison with a registration check and label-free diagnostics of known power, sets thresholds on validation data alone and reports the false-positive volume actually realised on test, repeats each comparison over 15,552 defensible evaluation pipelines, and attaches paired subject-bootstrap intervals with multiplicity control. translated_title: MIRTO：一种用于脑部MRI无监督异常分割的配准门控、多元宇宙测试评估协议
translated_abstract: 脑部MRI的无监督异常检测（UAD）方法通常以单一分数进行排名，然而该分数依赖于一些很少被报告的选择：每个异常图如何与参考图像对齐、阈值如何设定以及在哪些数据上设定、使用何种假阳性预算、指标、聚合方式和病灶定义。我们提出MIRTO，一个使这些选择显式化并衡量其影响的评估协议。它通过配准检查和具有已知效力的无标签诊断来门控每次比较的几何结构，仅在验证数据上设定阈值并报告在测试集上实际实现的假阳性体积，在15,552种可辩护的评估流程上重复每次比较，并附带经过多重性控制的配对受试者bootstrap置信区间。将MIRTO应用于四个在相同健康数据上训练并在312例BraTS 2020受试者上测试的UAD方法，结果显示存储数据的轴序不匹配……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: MIRTO提出了一种配准门控、多元宇宙测试的脑部MRI无监督异常分割评估协议，通过显式化图像对齐、阈值设定和指标选择等评估决策并量化其影响，揭示了这些常被忽略的选择对方法排名的显著作用。
